A spectroscopic indicator of blockage onset can only be a hypothesis, so the shortlist is conditional.

items.finding: Temperature sensitivity of OH bands in aqueous solutions in NIR and MIR makes tempered sample holders necessary.
items.how_it_applies: For the MIR ATR option, this suggests temperature control or measurement may be needed to reduce spectral interference from an aqueous slurry.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The source is a review of biopharmaceutical downstream processing, not a slurry pipe; tempered sample holders are not the same as an in-line process temperature sensor.

citation.quote: Additionally, the temperature sensitivity of the OH bands is a severe drawback for measuring aqueous solution in NIR and MIR, which makes tempered sample holders necessary [29].
citation.label: E03 ¶12

items.finding: The source lists pressure among parameters that fiber optic sensors can sense.
items.how_it_applies: This suggests pressure sensing is within broader fiber-optic sensor technology, but it does not show line pressure or flow rate measurement in a slurry pipe.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The source is an introductory paper and the quoted fragment does not cover flow, slurry, line pressure, or a specific product.

items.finding: For a continuous process at a fixed probe location, online monitoring focuses on drift and out-of-specification detection rather than resolving rapidly changing composition.
items.how_it_applies: This could inform a test of whether a fixed-probe spectroscopic system can flag out-of-specification states that might accompany blockage onset, but it does not address deposition or slurry blockage directly.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The source concerns reactive liquid-liquid extraction in lithium recycling, not a slurry transfer pipe; transfer to in-line slurry monitoring is uncertain.

citation.quote: In contrast, a continuous process at a fixed probe location is intended to operate in a steady-state window, which simplifies the model design: calibrations can be narrower and centered on the operational envelope, validation can rely on independent steady-state runs, and online monitoring focuses on drift and out-of-specification detection rather than resolving the rapidly changing composition.
citation.label: E01 ¶8

items.finding: ATR-FTIR combined with PCA was reported as valuable for real-time reaction monitoring and identifying faulty batches.
items.how_it_applies: This could support testing MIR ATR with multivariate analysis for abnormal-state detection, as a possible analogue to early blockage warning, but blockage itself is not measured.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The work is on polysiloxane formation, not slurry flow or pipe deposition; laboratory or process conditions may differ from in-line pipe conditions.

citation.quote: The combination of ATR-FTIR measurements and PCA proved to be a valuable tool for real-time reaction monitoring and identifying faulty batches.
citation.label: E02 ¶34
